title: SimpleDungeons
cue: 3D dungeons from rooms: corridors, doorways, stairs, floors
summary: Random 3D dungeons: rooms placed on a grid of one or more floors and joined by corridors and stairs, from the game's own room scenes or from box rooms built in code, with colliders, in milliseconds.
useWhen: A 3D game needs a level of rooms and corridors that is different every run: a dungeon crawler, a roguelike, a horror maze, a space station, an office or a mansion with floors. A seed gives the same level again.
avoidWhen: The level is designed by hand, lies outdoors, or is a 2D or tile map, which gaea generates.
